strategy_lineage: us-value-role-substitution-v1; frozen nfci-dual-core-v11 signal and target path on a 2004-01-30+ common window
hypothesis: The frozen V11 broad-U.S.-equity portfolio role may be leaving an independent long-run value risk premium unused. Replacing only the realized asset return carried by V11's sp500 output slot with a fixed large/mid-value ETF (IWD) or a fixed small-value ETF (VBR), while preserving every V11 signal date, target weight, currency treatment, risk reduction, fee, and rebalance rule, can improve common-window CAGR and risk-adjusted performance without increasing gross exposure.

literature_basis.IWD: iShares Russell 1000 Value ETF; fixed large/mid-cap U.S. value exposure, official inception 2000-05-22
literature_basis.VBR: Vanguard Small-Cap Value ETF; fixed U.S. small-cap value exposure, official inception 2004-01-26
literature_basis.economic_basis: long-horizon value premia have extensive cross-market empirical support; this trial tests investable value-role P&L rather than a fitted value timing signal

allowed_changes: F-IWD-SP500-ROLE replaces only the realized USD adjusted-close total-return series carried by the frozen V11 sp500 portfolio role with IWD; the asset option, role key, USD/CNY conversion, V11 signals and V11 target weights remain unchanged
F-VBR-SP500-ROLE performs the identical role substitution using VBR

the common evaluation starts 2004-01-30, the first available VBR adjusted-close date; V11-CONTROL is independently rerun from cash on exactly the same common window rather than compared with the longer 2002 baseline
both candidates are preregistered independently before either candidate performance is viewed and both remain permanently in G3/global multiple-testing accounting regardless of outcome
selection_metric: No winner selection, blend search, or survivor reporting. Each role candidate is assessed independently against the same common-window frozen V11 control. A pass by one candidate does not erase or modify the other candidate's trial count or result.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= V11-CONTROL Sharpe in the same fold
deterministic: target gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or shorting
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks against the common-window V11 control, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO/winner-selection test: not applicable because neither candidate may be selected as a family winner; both are independently reported
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using all prior 34 formal return-seeking candidates plus both current candidates, total trial count 36
ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS for a candidate requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This retrospective value-role campaign ends after the two frozen substitutions are opened. Do not rescue either result by blending IWD/VBR with S&P 500, mixing IWD and VBR, changing the substitution percentage, changing the common start, switching between value ETFs, adding a third value ETF, timing the value role, changing the V11 target path, or selecting only the nicer candidate for reporting. Any materially different asset role requires a new preregistered campaign and a new trial count.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_us_value_role_substitution_v1.py -> tools/us_value_role_substitution_v1.swiftpart -> frozen V11 common-window source run + immutable source-event target replay with alternative sp500-role realized-return series -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL common-window metrics, source-event count, and target fingerprint
F-IWD-SP500-ROLE common-window metrics, 2020+ and 2022+ slices, seven fixed folds and constraints
F-VBR-SP500-ROLE common-window metrics, 2020+ and 2022+ slices, seven fixed folds and constraints
identity replay proving that unchanged common-window inputs reproduce the source V11 metrics
mechanical deterministic ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS flags for both candidates
paired 20000-replicate bootstrap statistics for both candidates
cumulative 36-trial Deflated Sharpe Ratio for both candidates using an inventory that includes both current candidates
mechanical ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS flags for both candidates
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit, and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

F-IWD-SP500-ROLE.role: replace the realized-return series under V11 role key sp500
F-IWD-SP500-ROLE.price_field: Yahoo adjusted_close used as a total-return proxy
F-IWD-SP500-ROLE.signal_use: none; IWD prices affect only realized portfolio P&L, not V11 signals or target weights

F-VBR-SP500-ROLE.role: replace the realized-return series under V11 role key sp500
F-VBR-SP500-ROLE.price_field: Yahoo adjusted_close used as a total-return proxy
F-VBR-SP500-ROLE.signal_use: none; VBR prices affect only realized portfolio P&L, not V11 signals or target weights

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 signal, parameter, event date, target sizing, or target-path modification
any post-result IWD/VBR blend or blend with S&P 500
any substitution fraction other than exactly 100% of the sp500 role
any candidate selection that hides, removes, or downweights the other preregistered candidate from G3/DSR accounting
any alternative value ETF, value index, small-cap ETF, factor score, or third candidate after results
any value timing, moving average, relative-strength, valuation threshold, momentum confirmation, or regime gate
any common-evaluation-start change after performance is viewed
any leverage, financing, negative cash, or gross exposure above 100%
using future IWD/VBR returns to alter V11 signals or target weights

statistical_audit.global_dsr_return_window: each candidate's full common-window portfolio history

factor_library_archival.policy: Do not upload IWD/VBR role substitutions as factor-library factors. Preserve them as strategy-validation artifacts/results only.
